text_block_list.text:
—With the Fan Appreciation Festival over, 
and daily training resumed, one night... 
Feeling an inexplicable sense of unease, I 
returned to the academy, and...

On the deserted training track, I found 
her standing all alone.
She was—crying.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You saw an unsightly side of me. Tears 
of frustration accomplish nothing, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I should be spurring myself on 
and bouncing back immediately. Even though 
I understand that... I can't help feeling 
the bitter taste of my own helplessness."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I am unfit to be the “Emperor,” it seems.

I instantly knew they were talking about 
her uncharacteristic, lackluster run 
during the recent Fan Appreciation Day.
choice_data_list:
I was just worn out the other day, that's 
all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No... that's not it. I'm not judging 
myself based on a single defeat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The culmination of everything built up 
until now showed its results in the last 
race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why... it is so agonizingly 
painful...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—I've been striving relentlessly toward 
my ideals."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my dream, I've dragged 
everyone along, pushed them around, and 
made unreasonable demands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so I feigned confidence, telling them 
to place their faith in me as the mighty 
'Emperor.' For in doing so, they would 
find happiness, or so I claimed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And at the end of it all— that mediocre 
run the other day was what awaited her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She might have certainly delivered 
results. However, if she comes to a 
complete halt, it's all meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Because my ideals lie solely in the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I... I've come to a complete 
stop."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, that paper-thin veneer of 
prestige was exposed to the light of day.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wait... What was that run just now...? 
That didn't look like "The Emperor" at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No way, the President is...? I wonder 
what's gotten into her...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must have let everyone down terribly... 
including you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No... that's not it. I was the one who 
betrayed them."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps, from the very beginning... I 
never had the caliber to be the 
'Emperor.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What... what should I do...?

Her eyes, filled with pain and anguish, 
gaze my way. For the first time now, she 
has truly relied on me.

—And the words I needed to say now were 
already prepared, drawn from the journey I 
had shared with her.
choice_data_list: You don't need to do anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Huh?
choice_data_list: Just keep going as you are now.
Just keep going as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...What is the meaning of this?
choice_data_list: Without a doubt, you are the "Emperor."
Without a doubt, you are the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
On what basis do you say that...? You 
don't need to mince words just to cheer me 
up.
choice_data_list: The proof is right before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Right in front of me?
She was mistaken, if only slightly.

The strength required of the "Emperor" is 
not to shoulder everything alone. ――It is 
to captivate and move everyone.

And that outcome had already been shown by 
the path taken up to now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huh...
(Dadada...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Students
text_block_list.text: Presideeeeeeent!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Why are you here...?

Where Symboli Rudolf was looking, a large 
crowd of Tracen Academy's Umamusume had 
rushed over to gather.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It was time for our meeting regarding the 
general student assembly, so I stopped by 
your room, but you were not present.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I only asked the students if they'd seen 
it, and it ended up turning into a crowd 
of this size..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, I've caused you trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're here about the staff assignments, 
right? My apologies, but I haven't even 
finished the rough draft—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no need for that. I have 
already drafted most of the plan on my 
end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian will serve as the master of 
ceremonies for the day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...You really should be the one to do it, 
Air Groove. You're far better at public 
speaking anyway."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have the entire event's proceedings to 
manage, including backstage. We've already 
talked about this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Handling the overall progression and 
MCing is normally my job every year. So 
why...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see. So they really have 
abandoned me after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You judged that no happiness lies at the 
end of the path I lead... That is your 
verdict, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I understand. If I am an "Emperor" no 
longer desired, then I shall gracefully—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Whatever are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We are simply each taking the actions we 
currently deem appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Having the Student Council President stand 
on stage while still exhausted is utterly 
out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—We must always allow our "Emperor" to 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Since I had reassigned my trainee, I 
entrusted the remaining suspended duties 
to the dorm head.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! We're in charge of guiding 
people before and after the ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I asked the other girls in the dorm 
for help, they all gladly agreed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for the President..." they said. 
In fact, it was quite a battle over who'd 
get the assignment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that would cause trouble for 
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's no trouble at all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because the President is always working so 
hard for our sake.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Our classmates were super motivated too! 
No matter what kind of help is needed, 
they'll tackle it all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Leave the heavy lifting to me! I'll get 
these muscles burning!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: “—Madam President. Do you remember now?”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We, too, walk the same path and chase the 
same dream alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am not merely waiting for the happiness 
you bring. ...I wish to grasp it together 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So... please do not think that I will only 
ever defend.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Because everyone here is running on 
their own two legs!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I... see... Right, that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"To think I forgot even that. Haha... That 
goes beyond mere carelessness."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems I have a bad habit of keeping 
everything to myself. I had completely 
forgotten to listen to the voices around 
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list:
And everything you've built up until now, 
too.

And everything you've built up until now, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I believe you. Of course I do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone. Thank you...

"What shone in Symboli Rudolf's eyes right 
now was not tears, but a resolute will."
